The quiet harbour

This book was written for a disposable Bookfin reading test. No private library or published story is used.

Morning light filled the quiet harbour. Mira carried a lantern to the old reading room, where every shelf held a different journey.

The sepia square below is a local PNG image.

The next square is a local JPEG image.

Visit the lantern room
